title: Director of Quality & Compliance
text:
Exciting leadership opportunity with a growing skin care manufacturing company. At Episciences, the Director of Quality and Compliance is responsible for ensuring the marketing compliance of topical skin care products domestically and internationally and has oversight of manufacturing quality assurance and control processes in-house and at third party testing facilities. The ideal candidate will have working knowledge/experience of FDA cosmetic and OTC drug regulations; EU, UK, and Canada cosmetic regulations; and cGMP. The Director of Quality and Compliance routinely monitors current and new regulations to ensure products are compliant within all intended markets.

As the head of the Quality Control and Assurance team, the Director of Quality and Compliance is responsible for the review/approval and maintenance of master product formulae, master labeling copies and maintenance of standard operating procedures. The Director of Quality and Compliance also reviews and trends: customer complaints, raw materials, quality processes and finished product testing for release to Manufacturing,

Ideal Qualifications for this Position:

* Bachelor’s degree in chemistry is preferred

* 5+ years of management experience is preferred

* 5+ years of experience in food, drug and/or cosmetic manufacturing GMPs and Regulatory

* Ability to read and comprehend FDA CFRs as well as other domestic and international Regulatory documentation

* Excellent communication and presentation skills

* Excellent organization, filing and document writing skills

* FDA audit experience is a plus

What to expect as the Director of Quality and Compliance at Episciences Inc.:

* Discounted award-winning Episciences Inc. products

* A Business Casual Company and Culture

* Company paid medical, dental, vision and life insurance coverages

* Company matching retirement plan

* Paid holidays (11 per calendar year)

* Vacation and PTO accrual
